qualification: Local helper/localhost protocol evidence only; hosted roundtrip, failed-job rerun and full latest-attempt certification remain Phase 11.

resolvedFindings.issue: SDK discarded non-JSON HTTP service status
resolvedFindings.resolution: Official one-call HTTP transport classifies HTTP before JSON, with internal retries/redirects disabled; actual HTML502/503 and malformed200 tests pass.

resolvedFindings.issue: Concurrent artifact creation invalidated paginated list totals
resolvedFindings.resolution: Changed/incomplete snapshots are transient under the shared bounded recovery operation; malformed stable identities remain permanent.

resolvedFindings.issue: Azure BlobClient constructor requires options in the third argument
resolvedFindings.resolution: Actual success protocol fixture caught and now verifies correct overload with two blocks, ordered commit, byte-exact ZIP, hash and Create/Finalize identity.

resolvedFindings.issue: Shell steps do not receive runtime artifact credentials
resolvedFindings.resolution: Local JavaScript launcher inherits runner runtime credentials without persisting them to GITHUB_ENV; launcher fixture verifies literal argv.

resolvedFindings.issue: Large downloads and extraction could exceed memory or leave partial files
resolvedFindings.resolution: Stream to disk, verify API digest, stage extraction before no-overwrite installation, and enforce aggregate/per-attempt wall deadlines.

resolvedFindings.issue: Cancellation could leave separately grouped upload worker alive
resolvedFindings.resolution: SIGTERM/SIGINT unwind the Python transport, retain terminal receipt and kill worker group.

resolvedFindings.issue: Expired older producer poisoned an explicitly regenerated newer producer
resolvedFindings.resolution: Select latest successful producer attempt before validating its receipts; selected invalid artifacts still fail closed.
